1.text: Nzahagarara hejuru y'umunara aho ndindira, kandi nzarangaguza ndeba aho ari numve icyo ambwira, n'uko nzasubiza ku bw'icyo namuganyiye.

2.text: Maze Uwiteka aransubiza ati “Andika ibyerekanywe ubigaragaze ku mbaho, kugira ngo ubisomye abyihutire.

3.text: Kuko ibyerekanywe bifite igihe byategekewe, ntibizatinda kukigeraho kandi ntibizabeshya, naho byatinda ubitegereze, kuko kuza ko bizaza ntibizahera.

4.text: Dore umutima we wishyize hejuru ntumutunganyemo, ariko umukiranutsi azabeshwaho no kwizera kwe.

5.text: “Ni ukuri na vino iramuriganya, ni umuntu ugamika kandi urarikira ntaregama iwe, agwiza irari nk'iry'ikuzimu kandi ameze nk'urupfu ntagira ubwo ahaga, ahubwo yikoranyirizaho amahanga yose, akiyegereza amoko yose.

6.text: Abo bose se ntibazamuciraho umugani wo kumushinyagurira? Bazavuga bati ‘Azagusha ishyano ugwiza ibitari ibye! Azageza ryari? Uwigerekaho kwishingira azagusha ishyano!’

7.text: “Mbese abazaguhōra ntibazagutera bagutunguye, n'abazagukura umutima ntibazakubyukana ngo bakugire umunyago wabo?

8.text: Ubwo wanyaze amahanga menshi, amoko yose yasigaye nawe azakunyaga aguhoye amaraso y'abantu n'urugomo igihugu cyagiriwe, n'umurwa n'abawutuyemo bose.

9.text: “Azagusha ishyano ushakira inzu ye inyungu mbi kugira ngo yiyarikire icyari cye hejuru, ngo abone uko akira ukuboko k'umubi!

10.text: Inzu yawe wayiteje ibikoza isoni kuko warimbuye amoko menshi, ugacumurira ubugingo bwawe.

11.text: Kuko ibuye rizatakira ku nkike, kandi isōko yo mu gisenge cy'inzu izarisubiza.

12.text: “Azagusha ishyano uwubakisha umudugudu kuwuvusha amaraso, agakomeresha umudugudu gukiranirwa!

13.text: Uwiteka Nyiringabo si we utuma abantu bakorera ibizatwikwa n'umuriro, n'amahanga akiruhiriza ubusa?

14.text: Kuko isi izakwirwa no kumenya ubwiza bw'Uwiteka, nk'uko inyanja y'amazi isendēra.

15.text: “Azagusha ishyano uha umuturanyi we ibyokunywa, nawe umwongeraho ubumara bwawe bukamusindisha, kugira ngo urebe ubwambure bwe!

16.text: Wuzuweho no gukorwa n'isoni mu kigwi cy'icyubahiro, nawe unywe umere nk'utakebwe, igikombe kiri mu kuboko kw'iburyo k'Uwiteka kigiye kuguhindukiriraho, kandi isoni ziteye ishozi zizaba ku cyubahiro cyawe.

17.text: Kuko urugomo i Lebanoni hagiriwe no kurimbuka kw'inyamaswa kwabateye ubwoba, bizakugeraho ku bw'amaraso y'abantu n'urugomo igihugu cyagiriwe, ndetse n'umurwa n'abawutuyemo bose.

18.text: “Igishushanyo kibajwe kimaze iki, byatera umubaji wacyo kurushya akibaza? Igishushanyo kiyagijwe n'uwigisha ibinyoma, bimaze iki byatuma uwakibumbye acyiringira, akarema ibigirwamana bitavuga?

19.text: Azagusha ishyano ubwira igiti ati ‘Kanguka’, akabwira n'ibuye ritavuga ati ‘Haguruka!’ Mbese ibyo byakwigisha? Dore byayagirijweho izahabu n'ifeza, kandi nta mwuka bifite rwose.

20.text: “Ariko Uwiteka ari mu rusengero rwe rwera, isi yose iturize imbere ye.”
